description: Source code for the ICM42605 sensor driver in Zephyr RTOS, including sensor data conversion, fetch, configuration, and initialization functions.

methods.name: icm42605_convert_accel
methods.description: Converts raw accelerometer data to sensor_value format.

methods.name: icm42605_convert_gyro
methods.description: Converts raw gyroscope data to sensor_value format.

methods.name: icm42605_convert_temp
methods.description: Converts raw temperature data to sensor_value format.

methods.name: icm42605_channel_get
methods.description: Retrieves sensor data for specified channel.

methods.name: icm42605_tap_fetch
methods.description: Fetches tap detection events from sensor.

methods.name: icm42605_attr_set
methods.description: Sets sensor attributes such as sampling frequency and full scale.

methods.name: icm42605_init
methods.description: Initializes the sensor device and hardware.
